The birds exhibit characteristic glossy black plumage with visible white undertail coverts and red eyebrow combs. A third dark shape, likely another bird or rock, is partially visible in the background. The foreground bird is walking left, while the mid-ground bird stands facing right.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both visible male birds clearly display the distinctive red supra-orbital combs above their eyes.
